# TPC-DS Q60 — Three-Channel Sales by Item (Category)

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Union of store/catalog/web sales by item filtered by category

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Children')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 9 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Children')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 9 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Children')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 9 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id, total_sales LIMIT 100
```
